headline: Colts Trade Quenton Nelson To Seahawks
summary: Quenton Nelson is on an expiring contract, and his time with the Colts is coming to an end well before the 2026 season concludes. The All-Pro guard is on the move. Nelson is being traded to the Seahawks, as first reported by ESPN’s Adam Schefter and NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport. Indianapolis will receive a 2027 third-round pick as […]

headline: 49ers Reacquire DT DeForest Buckner
summary: A fire sale is in full swing in Indianapolis, which traded potential Hall of Fame guard Quenton Nelson to Seattle earlier Tuesday. The Colts are now moving on from defensive tackle DeForest Buckner, who is going to the 49ers for a 2027 fourth-round pick, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer reports. The teams have since announced […]

headline: Matt LaFleur isn't ruling out imminent practice return for Micah Parsons
summary: Green Bay Packers edge rusher Micah Parsons might finally be back on the practice field next week, more than 10 months after he underwent surgery on his left knee.

headline: Report: Lamar Jackson is expected to return Sunday
summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson has not played since Oct. 4, missing the past three games with a high ankle sprain.

headline: Giants place RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. on IR with hamstring injury
summary: The Giants are placing RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. on injured reserve with a hamstring injury, with Devin Singletary expected to play a bigger role on offense.

headline: Colts Want Second-Round Pick Plus More For RB Jonathan Taylor
summary: The Colts began a fire sale this week, trading away guard Quenton Nelson and defensive tackle DeForest Buckner. More moves are expected, with running back Jonathan Taylor among the other players who could be dealt before the deadline.
